provenance.note: This document records INVENTORY and LAUNCH FEASIBILITY only. No MCP `initialize`/`tools/list` handshake and no LSP `initialize` was executed while producing it, therefore no per-entry reachability verdict is recorded anywhere in this file. Reachability is measured by the host-side probers (scripts/host_prober.ts, scripts/lsp_prober.ts) and nowhere else. scripts/validate_servers_manifest.ts validates structure and cross-document consistency; it measures presence, never reachability.

classificationCorrection.whatWasWrong: Every entry under `lsp` was filed as though it were a Language Server Protocol server. Three of the six entries are NOT language servers and never were. This is a MISCLASSIFICATION in the inventory, not a missing server, and it was silently inflating the LSP reachability DENOMINATOR from 3 to 6 — which depressed every genuine language server's measured coverage ratio by counting compiler CLIs, linter CLIs and a bare SDK against them.
classificationCorrection.whatChanged: Each `lsp` entry now carries an explicit `category`. `language-server` means a real LSP endpoint exists. The other three categories mean a real asset exists but it is not an LSP endpoint. NOTHING WAS DELETED: all six entries remain declared, all six are still probed and reported, and `lsp.servers` still lists all six. Only the SCORE DENOMINATOR is restricted to `category: "language-server"`, and both numbers are published side by side (declaredTotal and measurableTotal) so no consumer can be shown only the flattering one.

pyright.note: There is NO Servers Center asset for this server: E:\Servers-Center\servers\lsp\pyright does not exist, and the host manifest declares no entry for it either. `entry` is therefore deliberately OMITTED rather than invented. pyright-langserver.exe was located on the host PATH.

command.argsNote: `--stdio` is REQUIRED, not decorative. Measured: with the full host environment and no arguments, pyright-langserver exits 1 with "Error: Connection input stream is not set. Use arguments of createConnection or set command line parameters: '--node-ipc', '--stdio' or '--socket={number}'".

env.passThroughNote: pyright-langserver is a CPython entry-point shim, and the `pyright` package lives in the PER-USER site-packages at C:\Users\<user>\AppData\Roaming\Python\Python314\site-packages. CPython derives its user-site directory from %APPDATA%; a child process started without APPDATA therefore cannot import the package at all. Measured consequence: the interpreter exits 1 with `ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'pyright'` before writing a single byte to stdout. Declared here so scripts/lsp_prober.ts can inject exactly this one variable from its own (host-side) environment instead of guessing, and so no host secret is inherited — only names are declared, and only values of declared names are ever read.
